summary: The diff implements fixes for both REQ-1 (gpioHttp.ts fetch configuration) and REQ-2 (DebugHttpPanel send button behavior). REQ-1 is addressed by removing no-cors mode, adding proper Content-Type headers, improving error handling with meaningful messages, and surfacing failures via toast notifications in useSignalEmitter.ts. REQ-2 is addressed by rewriting DebugHttpPanel.tsx to correctly call sendGpioSignal, display success/failure results, and properly manage loading state. All acceptance criteria appear to be covered.
